changeSet.author: nexus-uxd2a
changeSet.comment:
nexus-uxd2a: one-off data correction for nexus.catalog_collections rows already registered by hygiene-002-2's buggy gc_quarantine_orphans body (live between engine-service-v0.1.109 and this fix) — a quarantine-shaped row (name prefixed "quarantine-" or suffixed "__quarantine") whose content_type still carries a literal "quarantine-" prefix or the 'unknown' fallback. When the row's origin sibling (its name with the prefix/suffix stripped) is registered, every attribute is copied from it and lifecycle_state is set to 'quarantine' — otherwise only the literal "quarantine-" prefix is stripped from content_type (skipped if that would leave it blank), and lifecycle_state is left exactly as it is. This changeset NEVER fails on data (2026-08-16 never-wedge directive): every branch below is a plain UPDATE ... FROM / correlated UPDATE, no RAISE EXCEPTION path, so an install with zero eligible rows (the common case) runs as a no-op DML pass. Coordinator addition (nexus-71, 2026-09-09): the v0.1.109 first-request ghost-sweep demoted at least one quarantine-shaped row to 'dormant' before nexus-snm4y's hold landed (known live case: quarantine-rdr__1-1__voyage-context-3__v1 on tenant nexus, content_type already 'rdr') — a quarantine sibling is never truly dormant (it exists only because gc_quarantine_orphans put chunks there), so a THIRD, independent UPDATE promotes any quarantine-shaped 'dormant' row back to 'quarantine'.
SCOPE: touches ONLY nexus.catalog_collections, self-joined to itself for the origin-sibling lookup — no other table is read. RLS: catalog_collections carries FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, so it alone is toggled NO FORCE for this changeset's duration and restored FORCE immediately after (Approved Shape 1, toggle- wrapped, tests/test_changelog_rls_lint.py) — unlike hygiene-002-1/ hygiene-004-1, no vector-stats join means chunks/ catalog_document_chunks/catalog_documents need no toggle here.
IDEMPOTENCE: after this changeset runs once, no row can still satisfy any of the three UPDATEs' WHERE clauses (a corrected content_type never re-matches 'quarantine-%'/'unknown' at the SAME time as being a quarantine-shaped name with a NOW-different content_type value, and a promoted lifecycle_state is no longer 'dormant') — a hypothetical re-run finds zero rows, independent of Liquibase's own once-only checksum guarantee.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; LOCK TABLE nexus.catalog_collections IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
